A. Integration go-live checklist

Status vocabulary: LIVE implemented and tested against mocks/local; CONFIG code exists but production credentials/dashboard work remains; MOCK only a mock adapter exists; NOT BUILT no implementation. "Blocker" means the item must be complete before the first live transaction or before the production process will boot.

* Mono is not a production boot blocker, but Goods Flex cannot go live without it (or another open-banking provider) because the credit limit depends on a real bank assessment. If Flex is feature-flagged off at launch, Mono can follow.

Top five blockers, in order
1. Licensed escrow/payment partner (Protected Checkout cannot launch without it). 2. Licensed lender (Goods Flex cannot launch without it). 3. Payment provider certification (no live money). 4. Production deployment + managed infrastructure (nothing is live). 5. KYC + SMS/email + captcha (security and account recovery).

B. Environment variables

VariablePurpose / production requirement
ENVIRONMENTdevelopment | test | staging | production. Controls boot guards and dev routes.
DATABASE_URLPostgreSQL DSN; must use sslmode=require/verify-full in production.
DB_POOL_SIZE / DB_MAX_OVERFLOW / DB_POOL_TIMEOUTPer-process pool; size against Postgres max_connections or PgBouncer.
REDIS_URLRequired in production; shared cache, rate limits, single-flight.
JWT_SECRET / OTP_SECRET / DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEYUnique per environment; production rejects dev defaults; back up the Fernet key.
FRONTEND_URL / CORS_ORIGINS / ADMIN_URLExplicit https origins; admin subdomain used in staff invites.
TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRSLoad balancer CIDRs; required in production for correct client IPs.
ADMIN_2FA_REQUIREDMust be true in production; admins enable TOTP before using the admin API.
PAYMENT_PROVIDERmock | paystack | flutterwave; mock refused in production.
ESCROW_PROVIDER / BNPL_PROVIDERMock only today; production refuses mock; real adapters required.
BANK_DATA_PROVIDER / MONO_* mock | mono; Mono keys server-side only; production refuses mock.
PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY / FLUTTERWAVE_*Provider credentials and webhook hash.
SMS_PROVIDER / TERMII_*console | termii; production refuses console.
EMAIL_PROVIDER / SMTP_* / POSTMARK_*console | smtp | postmark; production refuses console.
STORAGE_BACKEND / S3_* / MEDIA_BASE_URLlocal | s3; production requires s3 + bucket; CDN URL for media.
CAPTCHA_PROVIDER / *_SITE_KEY / *_SECRET_KEYoff | mock | recaptcha | turnstile; production refuses mock/off.
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID / SECRETGoogle OAuth; hidden in production when absent.
META_CAPI_ACCESS_TOKEN / META_GRAPH_VERSIONServer-side purchase events; token never in DB/client.
FEED_TOKENOptional protection for Google/Meta feeds.
PLATFORM_COMMISSION_RATE / PROTECTION_FEE_RATE / PROTECTION_FEE_CAPMarketplace economics; admin-overridable.
AUTO_RELEASE_DAYSBuyer-confirmation window before escrow release (default 3).
RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE / RATE_LIMIT_IP_MULTIPLIERPer-identity and coarse per-IP ceilings.
MAX_UPLOAD_MB / MAX_IMAGES_PER_SELLER / DELETED_LISTING_RETENTION_DAYSMedia abuse and retention controls.
RATE_LIMIT_MULTIPLIERDev/test only; must be 1 outside development.

C. Glossary

TermMeaning
Protected CheckoutGoods.ng checkout where a licensed partner holds the buyer's funds until delivery is confirmed or the dispute process resolves.
Escrow partnerA licensed third party that holds and releases funds. Goods.ng does not hold funds.
Goods FlexBuy-now-pay-later product with an affordability assessment, mandatory guarantor and instalments.
GuarantorA person who consents to cover a Flex borrower's obligation up to a stated, capped amount.
Premium sellerDerived status from an active paid subscription; unlocks contact buttons, analytics, banner and ranking.
PromotionA one-off paid visibility package for a single listing: TOP 7, TOP 30 or Boost Premium 28.
Boost PremiumPromotion tier that makes a listing eligible for the sponsored pool while it meets quality gates.
LedgerDouble-entry, append-only record of money movements; balanced at commit by a deferred trigger.
Seller payableLedger liability representing money owed to a seller after release, before disbursement.
Verify-before-trustServer-to-server payment verification with exact amount/currency; webhooks are only triggers.
IdempotencyThe property that retrying the same request has no additional effect.
Four-eyesA second, different admin must approve a dispute refund.
NDPANigeria Data Protection Act 2023.
FCCPCFederal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission; regulates digital lending conduct.
CBNCentral Bank of Nigeria; licenses payment/escrow institutions.
PPRPartial Prerendering (Next.js); static shell with streamed dynamic data.
FTSPostgreSQL full-text search.
PgBouncerConnection pooler used in front of Postgres at scale.
PITRPoint-in-time recovery for the database.
Prepared from the Goods.ng repository and verified build state on 8 November 2026. This document is a planning and acceptance baseline, not legal advice. Licensed partner terms, regulatory interpretations and go-live dates must be confirmed by counsel and the relevant providers.
